headline: September 6: Rubber prices rise on Asian exchanges
summary: Rubber contracts for September delivery rose together on the SHFE, SGX and TOCOM exchanges. Domestic purchase prices in Vietnam were generally flat, with some latex prices around 420 to 540 VND per kg.
why: Natural rubber is an agricultural commodity used mainly in tyres, and its futures prices reflect supply and demand across Asian producers and manufacturers.
